when the sons of God had arrived and they stood before the Lord,
and he stood in his sight.
ut diceret Dominus ad Satan: Unde venis?
So the Lord said to Satan, “Where do you come from?”
And the Lord said to Satan,
quod non sit ei similis in terra,
that there is no one like him in the land,
fearing God and withdrawing from evil,
tu autem commovisti me adversus eum,
Yet you have stirred me against him,
so that I would afflict him to no purpose.”
et cuncta quæ habet homo dabit pro anima sua;
and everything that a man has, he will give for his life.
alioquin mitte manum tuam, et tange os ejus et carnem,
Yet send your hand and touch his bone and his flesh,
et tunc videbis quod in faciem benedicat tibi.
and then you will see whether or not he blesses you to your face.”
Therefore, the Lord said to Satan,
but even so, spare his life.”
Egressus igitur Satan a facie Domini,
Satan departed from the face of the Lord
a planta pedis usque ad verticem ejus;
and he struck Job with a very serious ulcer from the sole of the foot all the way to the crown of his head.
So he took a shard of earthenware and scraped the discharge,
while sitting on a heap of refuse.
But his wife said to him,
Adhuc tu permanes in simplicitate tua?
“Do you still continue in your simplicity?
Quasi una de stultis mulieribus locuta es:
“You have spoken like one of the foolish wives.
si bona suscepimus de manu Dei,
If we accepted good things from the hand of God,
why should we not accept bad things?”
In omnibus his non peccavit Job labiis suis.
In all this, Job did not sin with his lips.
Igitur audientes tres amici Job omne malum quod accidisset ei,
And so, three friends of Job, hearing about all the evil that had befallen him,
arrived, each one from his own place,
Condixerant enim ut pariter venientes visitarent eum, et consolarentur.
For they had agreed to come together to visit and console him.
And when they had raised up their eyes from a distance,
scissisque vestibus sparserunt pulverem super caput suum in cælum.
and, tearing their garments, they scattered dust over their heads into the sky.
Et sederunt cum eo in terra septem diebus et septem noctibus:
And they sat with him on the ground for seven days and seven nights,
and no one spoke a word to him,
for they saw that his sorrow was very great.
